title: fix(metadata-protocol): name a stored object_extension conversion notice by its target, one notice per row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ82Kk5X4KDzo3EwRJCHqDmGG)_

Fixes #29596

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:协议层存量行转换告警改用条目自身的身份命名,`object_extension` 用其 `extend` 目标,每行各报一条。
- 为什么改:扩展体没有 `name`,此前所有过期扩展行都报成 `object_extension/` 加 unnamed 占位,且共用一个去重键,三行只报一条。
- 风险与回滚:只动告警文字与去重键,行的转换结果不变;其它类型照旧按 `name` 命名。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-stored-item-conversion.ts` 的一行 `listSlotNameOf`;其次新测试文件。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol-stored-item-conversion.notice-name.test.ts`,应见 4 个测试通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-stored-item-conversion.ts` `convertStoredItem`: the notice's name, and the warn-once key built from it, read `listSlotNameOf(singular, data)` instead of `data.name`. That helper is the one list reads already slot an item by: an item's own `name`, and for an `object_extension` body (which carries `extend` and no `name`) its target. The module header gains one sentence saying the notice's name read has changed since the #25467 move. No new spelling; the body is not given a `name`.
- `packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts`: **no change.** Measured below, its notice reads the stored row's `name` column, which for an extension row is already its target.
- Tests: `protocol-stored-item-conversion.notice-name.test.ts` (new) and one `describe` in `database-loader.test.ts`.
- `.changeset/29596-extension-notice-name.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (the function ships in its `dist`).

## Why

Measured first, on a real store: the runtime rig of `meta-object-extension-item.test.ts` (better-sqlite3 + real `ObjectQL` + real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`). Two extensions (`crm_account`, `crm_contact`) were saved and published through the save door into `com.acme.crm.custom`, then each stored row's `time` default was made stale (`12:00Z`). The rows were then read through `getMetaItems`, `getMetaItem` (twice) and `loadMetaFromDb`, and through a `DatabaseLoader` over the same engine. The probe was a scratch test and is not committed.

- **Protocol seam, `data.name`:** absent on all six `convertStoredItem` calls (`'name' in data` false; `extend` = `crm_account` / `crm_contact`). Output: ONE line, `[Protocol] stored object_extension/` followed by the unnamed placeholder, for both rows.
- **Database-loader seam, `row.name`:** `crm_account` and `crm_contact`, the target names the save door stores the rows under. Output: two lines, `[DatabaseLoader] stored object_extension/crm_account …` and `… /crm_contact …`.

So the card's premise holds for the protocol seam and not for the loader seam. The loader already names each row by the identity every type is stored under, so it only gets a pin.

## Tests

- `protocol-stored-item-conversion.notice-name.test.ts`, run through the module's own `convertStoredItem` over the real chain (`convertStoredItemDetailed`):
  - two stale extension rows give two notices, `object_extension/crm_account` and `object_extension/crm_contact`; the row still converts, and the body gains no `name`;
  - re-reading one row does not warn again (the dedupe still holds per row);
  - CONTROL: `object` rows are still named by `name` (`object/shift`, `object/rota`), and a nameless body still gets the unnamed placeholder;
  - CONTROL: an `extend` key on a non-extension type does not name it.
- `database-loader.test.ts` › `stored conversion notice names the row (#29596)`: two stale extension rows loaded through `loadMany` give two notices naming their targets, and the defaults come back converted. CONTROL: `object` rows are named by row name.

<details><summary>Ablation (committed first, restored by blob hash)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put the old read back (`const name = (data as { name?: unknown } | null | undefined)?.name;`). Anchor 1 → 0, blob `17ae402a` → `c4063b6d`. Result: 2 failed / 2 passed. Both extension cases fail with received `["object_extension/" + unnamed placeholder]` (one line for two rows); both CONTROLs stay green. Restored blob `17ae402a` == HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports the module from `src` by relative path, so no `dist` rebuild was involved.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- No overlap found before editing: of 37 open PRs, none touches either file. #29683 touches the sibling `protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` only. No live `Claim:` covers `convertStoredItem` or the loader's notice block; the cut-23 claim on #25467 is for the move that already landed.
- No `protocol.ts` or `packages/spec` edit.

  - NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package built). CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone. After fetching its pinned fixture commit, it exits 0.
- The derived run started at `de3bb7a9`. The final commit only types the two tests' `console.warn` spies. The 18 test-reading gates were rerun at `90c78f06`, all exit 0: engine-double-contract, objectql-double-limit, test-source-alias, cross-package-test-inputs, rest-log-spy-declared, refd-timer-probe, where-matcher, logger-receiver-detach, nul-bytes, issue-citations (both), comment-mask-adoption, durability-log-level, registry-log-declared, system-context-census, tier-file-adoption, type-check-coverage, keyed-text-bounds.
